# Phase 2 Tasks Checklist: QuickFlow Personal Productivity Workspace

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality check for the Phase 2 (User Story 1 - Manage tasks) acceptance criteria AS1-AS9 used by loop-3 testing: task fields and defaults, validation, overdue rule, archive/restore/delete, search/filter/sort, API errors and UX states.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive): depth Standard, audience Reviewer (testing loop), focus US1 acceptance criteria + validation/API errors + UX states.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the default values for status (Todo) and priority (Medium) stated for every creation path, including when a status other than Todo is supplied at creation? [Completeness, Spec §US1 AS1, §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the behaviour of fields omitted on edit (status, priority, description, due date) specified — kept or cleared? [Gap, Spec §US1 AS3]
- [ ] CHK003 Is whether title whitespace is trimmed before the 1-200 length rule is applied specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the meaning of "show archived" defined — archived only, or archived plus active? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §US1 AS5]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for completing a task that is already Done (completion time kept or reset)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §US1 AS4]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the content of validation messages (what each message must explain) specified for empty title, over-length title and over-length description? [Completeness, Spec §US1 AS2]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "before today" in the overdue rule tied to the user's local time zone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases "Time zone"]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the default sort order of the task list (field and direction) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the due-date range filter defined as inclusive or exclusive at both ends? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the search defined as substring match on title only, and is the handling of wildcard characters (`%`, `_`) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §US1 AS7]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "last-updated time changes" defined for actions other than edit (complete, archive, restore)? [Clarity, Spec §US1 AS3]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Is the ordering of tasks without a due date consistent between ascending and descending due-date sort? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the empty-state wording consistent between "no tasks" and "no matches" cases across AS9 and FR-030? [Consistency, Spec §US1 AS9, §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the error status codes for invalid path ids, unknown enum values and malformed dates consistent with the shared problem+json error format? [Consistency, Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can "appears in the list" (AS1) be verified objectively given the default sort and filters? [Measurability, Spec §US1 AS1]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the 500 ms result time (SC-002, SC-009) measurable for search/filter with a defined data set? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-009]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are failure/recovery requirements defined when a save, complete, archive or delete request fails (rollback, user message)? [Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the cancel path of the delete confirmation specified? [Coverage, Spec §FR-031, §US1 AS6]
- [ ] CHK019 Are combined filters (search + status + priority + range + overdue) required to apply together (AND)? [Coverage, Spec §US1 AS7]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are boundary values (exactly 200-char title, exactly 2,000-char description, due date equal to today) addressed? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK021 Is truncation of very long titles specified with how the full text is made available? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are keyboard and screen-reader requirements defined for the task form, toolbar and row actions (labelled controls, announced validation)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK023 Are animation limits (≤ 250 ms, reduced motion) specified for task list enter/leave and completion feedback? [Clarity, Spec §FR-032]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the content negotiation of body-less responses (e.g. 204 on delete) defined for clients that only accept `application/problem+json`? [Assumption, Gap]

## Notes

- Generated non-interactively for loop-3 phase 2. `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
